title: Still Burning
html:
Osric Blane taught one apprentice, nine years ago. The fire that boy read took three houses and then went down into the ground, and it has been going northeast ever since. The Smoldering Den is named after it and nobody ever asked why.

About

Given byOsric Blane
Level11
LengthMedium
KindCombat skill unlocks
Quest points3

What you need

  • Melted Keepsake ×10

Steps

  1. Talk to Osric Blane (outdoors near Binxonia) to get the quest.
  2. Take 10 melted keepsakes back off the den imps (10) - Melted Keepsake at -27, 22
  3. Put down Vashel the Unquenched inside Smoldering Den
  4. Go back to Osric Blane at -28, 23

Some steps in between were not recorded.

or Oak Staff

What Osric Blane says

Osric Blane: Put them on the table.

Osric Blane: That one's the Meara girl's. Her mother had it off her grandmother and it hung in the window where you could see it from the road.

You: There are more down there.

Osric Blane: There will be. I'll take these round myself, and not tonight.

Osric Blane: Go back down. The floor gets warmer the further in you go, and I want to know what has been keeping it warm.

Osric Blane: Cold down there now?

You: Getting there.

Osric Blane: Nine years. That's the part nobody puts in a scroll. You will cast a thing that lands, and then keeps landing, and it will do that whether or not you are still standing there and whether or not you have changed your mind about it.

Osric Blane: Eril thought the spell ended when the saying ended. It's the only thing he got wrong and it cost three houses.

Osric Blane: Hold your hand out.

Handing it in

"Go and practice it somewhere with nothing behind it."
